transposable_ue.note: AI Max is a Google Ads campaign option available in Europe, so the setup transposes without a technical project. Two points need framing before turning it on in an EU market. First, conversion tracking, here insurance leads, which has to rest on a legal basis and a consent collection that comply with GDPR, failing which the signal driving the campaign degrades. Second, the automatic customization of ad text, which produces messages that are not reviewed one by one, while advertising for insurance products is regulated in several EU countries. So the elements the system may rephrase have to be bounded, and human validation kept on regulated wording.

pattern: AI-driven search campaign that customizes ad text and reaches long queries beyond the purchased keywords
objectif_business: Reach American drivers and households at the moment they search for insurance on Google, including on long and very specific queries the club had not bought as keywords, and bring down the cost of an insurance lead in a market where the search auction is among the most expensive.

Figures published by Alphabet, an interested party: no AAA or third-party source confirms them.
description: AAA Auto Club Enterprises is the largest federation of AAA clubs in the United States. Its careers site states that it serves more than 18 million members across 24 states, and auto and home insurance is one of its main revenue lines. On Google Ads, the club turned on AI Max for its Search campaigns. AI Max is a campaign option Google took out of beta in 2026: instead of staying within the purchased keywords, the system reads the advertiser's ads and site content to reach queries no keyword covered, rewrites the ad text based on the search entered, and picks the landing page closest to the request itself. What this changes for the user: someone typing a very specific search, for example a driver profile or a particular insurance situation, sees an AAA ad whose headline has been rewritten to match that search, and lands on the matching quote page rather than on a generic one. Philipp Schindler, chief business officer of Alphabet, cited this case when the second quarter 2026 results were published, stating that AAA Auto Club Enterprises was using it to customize its creative assets and capture the growth of increasingly detailed insurance searches. The exact scope of the rollout, number of campaigns, states covered, product lines, has not been published.

resultats.metrique: Increase in conversion volume on the Search campaigns moved to AI Max, according to Alphabet
Decrease in cost per lead over the same scope, according to Alphabet

niveau_preuve.justification: Both figures come from one and the same sentence, spoken by Philipp Schindler, chief business officer of Alphabet, during the second quarter 2026 earnings call on July 22, 2026. The sentence appears word for word in the official transcript published by Alphabet (S1) and in the full transcripts published by AlphaStreet (S2) and Investing.com (S3); the quote is anchored on S2, whose text is machine readable, where the official PDF exposes no extractable text layer. None of these three sources is independent: it is the same statement, and Alphabet is an interested party here, the seller of AI Max praising its product through a named advertiser. Searches on the Google Ads and Think with Google side turned up no AI Max case study citing AAA (the Think with Google page on AI Max cites ClickUp, Royal Canin and Klook, not AAA), and no established marketing press picks up or verifies the case. So there is no confirmation on the AAA side: no press release, no public appearance, no company figure isolating this effect. Not an A, for lack of financial reporting by the subject brand on its own result, and the B should be read with that reservation: a single voice, the platform's.

stack_technique.detail: A Google Ads campaign option out of beta in 2026. Google describes it as combining the elements provided by the advertiser, ads and site content, with richer signals, and it bundles three parts: search term matching, text customization and final URL expansion.
The advertiser account, conversion tracking and budget the AI Max campaign relies on.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Campaigns run continuously. Query matching, text rewriting and landing page selection are decided at each auction; human steering is a review rhythm, daily at launch then weekly.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The advertiser's paid acquisition team, or its SEA agency, with a compliance contact on the insurance side for what the machine is allowed to rephrase.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The conversions reported to Google Ads, here insurance leads (quote request, form, call). The system optimizes on this signal and on cost per lead. If the lead is reported without any quality attached, the campaign learns to produce form volume rather than policies; if tracking breaks or falls under consent, broad matching becomes blind spend.

statut_vivant.note: The case was cited as active on July 22, 2026, less than a month before verification, and AI Max is an expanding product: Google announced the automatic migration of Dynamic Search Ads campaigns to AI Max. No signal of a stop. The reservation is about the single source: it is Google talking about AAA's campaign, not AAA.

faq.q: What results did AAA Auto Club Enterprises get with AI Max?
faq.a: Alphabet announced on July 22, 2026 a 17% increase in conversion volume and an 11% decrease in cost per lead. These figures come from a single sentence in Alphabet's earnings call and are confirmed by no source on the AAA side.

faq.q: What is AI Max on Google Ads?
faq.a: A Search campaign option out of beta in 2026 that combines the advertiser's ads and site content with richer signals. It bundles broadened search term matching, ad text customization and automatic landing page selection.

faq.q: Can this case be replicated in Europe?
faq.a: Yes, AI Max is available in Google Ads in Europe. Two precautions: GDPR-compliant conversion tracking for insurance leads, and human validation of generated texts, since insurance advertising is regulated.
